summary: Two churches: Holy Spirit (Sat 4 PM, Sun 11 AM, Tue 6:30 PM Mass, Tuesday 7 PM Adoration and Confession) and Sacred Heart (Sun 9 AM Mass, Sunday Confession), all printed alike in five bulletins. The Monday to Friday 8 AM Mass is at the Sisters of the Resurrection, which is not on the church list, so it is left out. Open: the Wednesday rectory chapel Mass location, the Nov 2 school Mass and the Nov 7 Confirmation Mass.
